How We Work

How a Project Works at Homeland

A transparent, step-by-step journey from first call to final handover.

01

Free Site Visit

We visit your space, take exact measurements, and understand your lifestyle, storage needs, and aesthetic preferences — no generic questionnaires.

02

Design & Quote

Within 5 working days: 3D renders of key spaces, a materials specification sheet, and a fixed-price quote with no hidden escalations.

03

Execution

Our in-house team handles procurement, civil work, carpentry, and installation. You get daily WhatsApp updates and access to a live project tracker.

04

Handover

Final walkthrough, snag list resolved in 48 hours, and a 2-year warranty on all our workmanship — documented and signed.
